evidence_quotes: Faraday Lab, founded in 2023, aims to improve generative AI accessibility and diversity by training and fine-tuning LLMs on French language datasets to give AI access to everyone, without geographic limitation.
The startup’s original on-premises architecture wasn’t scalable, so it migrated to AWS and began using Amazon SageMaker —designed to build, train, and deploy machine learning models for any use case.
To scale its LLMs , Faraday Lab migrated to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
By using AWS and working with Data Reply France , an AWS Partner , Faraday Lab reduced LLM training time, increased inference speed, and maintained data sovereignty for its clients.
By training its LLMs on Amazon SageMaker, Faraday Lab improved its models’ accuracy.
Its ARIA 70B version 3 model has a massive multitask language understanding score of 64.75.
